title: Nelson-Barr Inflation
summary: The Nelson-Barr mechanism solves the strong CP problem through spontaneous CP violation, but the resulting CP-conjugate vacua generically lead to stable domain walls. We propose that the Nelson-Barr scalar itself drives hilltop inflation. A CP-symmetric double-well potential for its imaginary component forms two CP-breaking valleys, with inflation proceeding along one of them. Since the lowest CP-invariant ridge is generically much higher than the energy available after inflation, transitions between the two branches are energetically inaccessible, and the domain walls cannot be regenerated…
